<template>
	<BasicProfilePage
		:host="host"
		:size="size"
		advanced
		:heading-title="i18n.locale.value === 'en' ? 'Advanced profile' : '高级详情'"
		><template #workflow="{ record, readable }"
			><AdvancedWorkflow v-if="record" :record="record" :readable="readable" /></template
	></BasicProfilePage>
</template>
<script setup>
import { useBasicProfileText } from '../basic/I18n.js';
import BasicProfilePage from '../basic/BasicProfilePage.vue';
import AdvancedWorkflow from './AdvancedWorkflow.vue';
defineProps({
	host: { type: Object, required: true },
	size: { type: String, required: false }
});
const { i18n } = useBasicProfileText();
</script>

	><output v-if="diagnostics" id="advanced-flow-audit">{{ fixture.flowAudit }}</output>

	externalI18n: { type: Object, required: false },
	inheritAppearance: { type: Boolean, required: false },
	diagnostics: { type: Boolean, required: false }

const { i18n } = useBasicProfileText();
const fixture = createAdvancedProfileFixture(() => i18n.locale.value),
	factory = () => fixture;
const text = (zh, en) => (i18n.locale.value === 'en' ? en : zh);
function setFlow(value) {
	if (value === 'normal' || value === 'error' || value === 'unknown')
		fixture.flowControls.mode = value;
}
</script>
